blocks.text: Enzymes proteins hain jo jaandaron ke kimiyai reactions ke liye hayatiyati catalysts ka kaam karte hain; yeh biochemical reactions ko itna tez karte hain jitna in ke baghair na-mumkin hota. Maslan khoon ka enzyme carbonic anhydrase bohat bari tadaad mein carbon dioxide aur paani ke molecules ko carbonic acid mein badalta hai. (Kitab kehti hai taqreeban das lakh fi minute; napi gayi raftaar das lakh fi second ke qareeb hai.)

Enzyme ki satah par aik khaas jagah, active site, hoti hai jo substrate molecule ko jor kar products mein badalti hai. Enzymes bohat makhsoos hain: har aik sirf aik khaas substrate par kaam karta hai, kyunke active site ki anokhi shakal mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai. Be-tarteeb harkat substrate molecules ko active site mein lati hai, aur aarzi enzyme-substrate complex banta hai; phir products nikal jate aur enzyme, be-tabdeel, doosre substrate molecule se jurne ke liye azad hota hai. Yeh 1894 mein Emil Fischer ke pesh kiye lock and key model se samjhaya jata hai: enzyme taala aur substrate chaabi hai, aur sirf durust shakal ki chaabi surakh (active site) mein fit hoti hai.
Enzymes hazme mein bhi hissa lete hain: hazme ke enzymes starch, proteins aur charbi jaise khurak ke bare molecules ko chhote molecules mein torte hain jinhein jism jazb kar sake.

blocks.alt: Oopar: katore jaisa enzyme jis ki active site mein dandane, milti julti shakal ka substrate us mein fit ho kar enzyme-substrate complex banata, aur phir be-tabdeel enzyme do product molecules ke saath. Neeche baen: usi shakal ka competitive inhibitor active site mein baith jata, is liye substrate andar nahi aa sakta. Neeche daen: non-competitive inhibitor enzyme par kaheen aur jur kar active site ko bigar deta.
blocks.caption: Lock and key model aur inhibitors ka amal (Figures 27.7 se 27.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Substrate active site mein taale mein chaabi ki tarah fit hota, thori der ka complex banata aur products ban kar nikal jata hai, is liye aik enzyme molecule bohat baar kaam kar sakta hai. Competitive inhibitor substrate jaisa dikhta aur site band karta hai; non-competitive inhibitor kisi aur jagah se site ki shakal badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Enzyme sirf aik substrate par kyun kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki active site ki anokhi shakal (aur groups ki tarteeb) hai jis mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai, jaisa lock and key model mein.

items: Enzymes: protein catalysts; substrate active site se jurta.
Lock and key model (Fischer, 1894); enzymes khurak hazam karte.
